verdict.rationale: The docs say Mesh case management lets analysts prioritise and review risk alerts. Cases can be filtered by risk, stage, assignee and creation date, then decided and audited, in the UI or via the API. Transaction-monitoring cases and alerts also exist as an export type. However, nothing shows an analyst grouping multiple related subjects and transactions into a single investigation. Missing for 10: documented ability to link or group multiple customers/transactions into one investigation, explicit alert-prioritisation mechanics (scoring/queues), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
